Murad is going to ___ for a job at a bank.
questions.explain: apply for a job — işə müraciət etmək.

questions.question: She earns a good ___ — about 3,000 manat a month.
Please find the report ___ to this email.
questions.explain: E-poçtda: Please find … attached.

questions.question: I've been ___ holiday since Monday, so I haven't checked my email.
questions.explain: on holiday — sabit birləşmə.

questions.question: I'm sorry, I can't come to the meeting. Can we ___ it until Thursday?
questions.explain: put off = təxirə salmaq.

questions.question: Let's ___ the main points of the meeting before we finish.
questions.explain: summarise = xülasə etmək; “resume” yalançı dostdur (davam etdirmək).

questions.question: Our company had a very good year and made a big ___.
questions.explain: make a profit — mənfəət əldə etmək.

questions.question: We need to ___ our costs — we are spending too much.
questions.explain: cut costs — xərcləri azaltmaq.

questions.question: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
questions.explain: İnsanlar üçün “who” işlənir.

questions.question: Gabala is the town ___ I spent my holidays.
questions.explain: Yer bildirəndə “where” işlənir (= in which).

questions.question: That's the boy ___ father is a famous footballer.
questions.explain: Yiyəlik bildirmək üçün “whose” işlənir.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: My brother who lives in London, is an engineer.
My brother, that lives in London, is an engineer.
My brother, who lives in London, is an engineer.
My brother, which lives in London, is an engineer.
questions.explain: Vergüllü əlavə cümlədə “that” işlənmir, insan üçün “who” gəlir.

questions.question: In which sentence can we leave out the relative pronoun?
options: Baku, which I love, is beautiful.
The man who called you is here.
The dog that bit me ran away.
The film that we watched was boring.
questions.explain: Əvəzlik tamamlıq olanda (that we watched) onu buraxmaq olar.

questions.question: This is the book ___ I told you about.
questions.explain: Əşyalar üçün “which/that” işlənir, “what” yox.

questions.question: I'll never forget the day ___ I met my best friend.
questions.explain: Zaman bildirəndə “when” işlənir.

questions.question: I met a woman ___ car had broken down.
questions.explain: “whose car” = onun maşını.

questions.question: Baku, ___ is the capital of Azerbaijan, is on the Caspian Sea.
questions.explain: Vergüllü cümlədə əşya/yer üçün “which” işlənir, “that” yox.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The jacket I bought yesterday is too small.
The jacket I bought it yesterday is too small.
The jacket bought I yesterday is too small.
The jacket I bought which yesterday is too small.
questions.explain: Əvəzlik buraxılanda əlavə “it” işlənmir.

questions.question: I've got a friend ___ can speak five languages.
questions.explain: İnsan və subyekt: “who” (whom subyekt ola bilməz).

questions.question: 2020 was the year ___ we moved to Baku.
questions.explain: İl, gün kimi zaman sözlərindən sonra “when” gəlir.

questions.question: Is this the student ___ phone you found?
questions.explain: “whose phone” = kimin telefonu.

questions.question: Mr Ahmadov, ___ I met at the conference, gave me his business card.
questions.explain: Vergüllü cümlədə insan üçün “who” işlənir.

questions.question: Is this the key ___ looking for?
questions.explain: Tamamlıq olan əvəzliyi buraxmaq olar: the key (that) you were looking for.

questions.question: I don't mind ___ the dishes.
questions.explain: “mind”dan sonra feil -ing formasında gəlir.

questions.question: We've decided ___ a new car.
questions.explain: “decide”dan sonra to + feil gəlir.

questions.question: Nigar is very good at ___ cakes.
questions.explain: Ön sözdən (at) sonra feil -ing alır.

questions.question: It's important ___ enough water every day.
questions.explain: It's + sifət + to-məsdər.

questions.question: The view was so beautiful that we stopped ___ some photos.
questions.explain: stop to do = nəyisə etmək üçün dayanmaq.

questions.question: Tural really enjoys ___ chess with his grandfather.
questions.explain: “enjoy”dan sonra -ing işlənir.

questions.question: I hope ___ you again soon.
questions.explain: “hope”dan sonra to + feil gəlir.

questions.question: I'm looking forward ___ you.
questions.explain: “look forward to” — burada “to” ön sözdür, ona görə -ing gəlir.

questions.question: I was surprised ___ Murad at the party.
questions.explain: Hiss bildirən sifətdən sonra to-məsdər: surprised to see.

questions.question: I remember ___ to Sheki when I was a child. It was lovely.
questions.explain: remember + -ing = keçmişdə olanı xatırlamaq.

questions.question: You should avoid ___ too much sugar.
questions.explain: “avoid”dan sonra -ing işlənir.

questions.question: He promised ___ late again.
questions.explain: promise + (not) to + feil.

questions.question: Thank you ___ me with my homework.
questions.explain: thank you for + -ing.

questions.question: We were very sorry ___ that you were ill.
questions.explain: sorry to hear = eşitdiyimə təəssüflənirəm.

questions.question: Don't forget ___ the door when you leave!
questions.explain: forget to do = ediləcək işi unutmaq.

questions.question: When I arrived, the film had already ___.
questions.explain: Past Perfect: had + V3.

questions.question: When we got to the station, the train ___, so we waited for the next one.
questions.explain: Daha əvvəl baş vermiş hərəkət: had + V3.

questions.question: While I ___ home, it started to rain.
questions.explain: Davam edən fon hərəkəti: was/were + -ing.

questions.question: When I was a child, I ___ play in the street with my friends.
questions.explain: Keçmiş vərdiş: used to + feil.

questions.question: ___ the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.
questions.explain: “by the time” = ... gələnə qədər.

questions.question: She ___ never seen the sea before her trip to Baku.
questions.explain: Keçmişdəki bir andan əvvəl: had never + V3.

questions.question: After Murad ___ his homework, he went out to play football.
questions.explain: Birinci bitən hərəkət: had + V3.

questions.question: The sun ___ and the birds were singing when we arrived in Gabala.
questions.explain: Hekayədə fon təsviri: Past Continuous.

questions.question: Did you ___ have long hair?
questions.explain: Sual və inkarda “did” ilə “use to” yazılır.

questions.question: She phoned me as ___ as she heard the news.
questions.explain: “as soon as” = ... kimi, dərhal.

questions.question: ___ you ever been to Gabala before you moved there?
questions.explain: Past Perfect sualı: Had + subyekt + V3?

questions.question: I ___ hungry because I hadn't eaten all day.
questions.explain: Əsas hekayə hərəkəti Past Simple ilə: I was.

questions.question: What ___ you doing when the lights went out?
questions.explain: Kəsilən hərəkət: were you doing (Past Continuous).

questions.question: Every summer, my grandmother ___ take us to the village and cook for us.
questions.explain: Keçmişdə təkrarlanan hərəkət: would + feil.

questions.question: ___ she had locked the door, she went to bed.
questions.explain: Past Perfect ilə birinci hərəkət: After she had locked...

questions.question: The government made an important ___ yesterday.
questions.explain: decide felindən isim: decision (-sion).

questions.question: We need your ___ to use this photo on our website.
questions.explain: permit felindən isim: permission.

questions.question: The teacher was pleased with the ___ in my English.
questions.explain: improve felinə -ment artırılır: improvement.

questions.question: Money can't buy ___.
questions.explain: happy sifətindən isim: happiness (-ness).

questions.question: People fought for their ___ for many years.
questions.explain: free sifətindən isim: freedom (-dom).

questions.question: Her ___ to speak five languages is amazing.
questions.explain: able sifətindən isim: ability (-ity).

questions.question: My cousin plays the piano in an orchestra. She's a professional ___.
questions.explain: Musiqi alətində çalan şəxs -ist ilə bildirilir: pianist.

questions.question: A person who visits a museum is a ___.
questions.explain: visit felindən şəxs adı -or ilə düzəlir: visitor.

questions.question: A person who works in science is a ___.
questions.explain: science sözündən şəxs adı: scientist.

questions.question: My family ___ in a small flat in Baku.
questions.explain: family toplu isimdir; Present Simple-da lives (və ya live) işlənir, are live / is live səhvdir.

questions.question: A ___ of students is waiting outside the classroom.
questions.explain: İnsanlar üçün a group of işlənir; flock, herd heyvanlar üçündür.

questions.question: The police ___ looking for the thief.
questions.explain: police həmişə cəm fel tələb edir: the police are.

questions.question: What's the reason ___ your decision?
questions.explain: reason ismindən sonra for gəlir: the reason for.

questions.question: There has been an increase ___ the price of bread.
questions.explain: Nəyinsə artımı: an increase in.

questions.question: What's the difference ___ these two words?
questions.explain: İki şey arasındakı fərq: the difference between.

questions.question: Everyone in my class ___ a smartphone.
questions.explain: everyone tək fel tələb edir: everyone has.

questions.question: I knocked on the door, but ___ answered, so I went home.
questions.explain: Təsdiq feli ilə inkar mənası no one ilə verilir.

questions.question: Someone ___ left their umbrella in the classroom.
questions.explain: someone tək fel tələb edir: someone has.

questions.question: I didn't buy ___ at the market — everything was too expensive.
questions.explain: İnkar cümlədə anything işlənir; didn't + nothing ikiqat inkardır.

questions.question: There's ___ in the fridge. It's completely empty.
questions.explain: Təsdiq fellə inkar mənası: there's nothing.

questions.question: I can hear ___ outside. Who's there?
questions.explain: Təsdiq cümlədə something işlənir.

questions.question: Leyla and Nigar have known ___ since they were five.
questions.explain: Qarşılıqlı hərəkət: each other (bir-birini).

questions.question: We had a great time and really enjoyed ___ at the party.
questions.explain: enjoy oneself – əylənmək: we → ourselves.

questions.question: Which sentence means “A helps B and B helps A”?
questions.explain: Bir-birinə kömək: each other; themselves – özlərinə.

questions.question: This cup is dirty. Can I have ___ one, please?
questions.explain: Daha bir (fərqli) tək şey: another one.

questions.question: I have two brothers. One lives in Baku and ___ lives in Gabala.
questions.explain: İkidən qalan biri: the other.

questions.question: Some students went home, but ___ stayed to finish the project.
questions.explain: İsimsiz cəm məna: others (başqaları).

questions.question: ___ is a new café near my house.
questions.explain: Bir şeyin mövcudluğunu bildirmək üçün there is işlənir.

questions.question: ___ takes five hours to get from Baku to Sheki by bus.
questions.explain: Vaxt bildirəndə formal mübtəda it işlənir: it takes.

questions.question: Take an umbrella — ___ raining.
questions.explain: Hava haqqında it işlənir: it's raining.

questions.question: ___ Caspian Sea is the largest lake in the world.
questions.explain: Dəniz adlarından əvvəl the işlənir: the Caspian Sea.

questions.question: We went hiking in ___ Caucasus Mountains.
questions.explain: Dağ silsilələri the ilə işlənir: the Caucasus Mountains.

questions.question: Which is correct?
options: the Amazon and the Pacific Ocean
questions.explain: Çay və okean adları the ilə işlənir.

questions.question: My uncle lives in ___ United States.
questions.explain: States, Kingdom kimi sözlü ölkə adları the ilə işlənir: the United States.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: She has visited Italy and the UK.
She has visited the Italy and the UK.
She has visited Italy and UK.
She has visited the Italy and UK.
questions.explain: Əksər ölkə adları artiklsızdır, amma the UK the ilə işlənir.

questions.question: Have you ever been to ___ Lake Göygöl?
questions.explain: Lake + ad şəklində göl adları artiklsız işlənir.

questions.question: Nigar plays ___ violin in the school orchestra.
questions.explain: Musiqi alətlərində çalmaq: play the violin.

questions.question: My brother plays ___ basketball every weekend.
questions.explain: İdman növləri artiklsız işlənir: play basketball.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Tural plays the guitar and football.
Tural plays guitar and the football.
Tural plays the guitar and the football.
Tural plays a guitar and a football.
questions.explain: Alət the ilə, idman artiklsız: the guitar, football.

questions.question: The thief was caught and sent to ___ prison for three years.
questions.explain: Müəssisə öz məqsədi ilə işlənəndə artikl olmur: go to prison.

questions.question: Murad's mother went to ___ school to speak to his teacher.
questions.explain: Binaya başqa məqsədlə getdikdə the işlənir: went to the school.

questions.question: My grandfather is very ill. He's ___.
questions.explain: Xəstə kimi xəstəxanada olmaq (BrE): in hospital.

questions.question: ___ an endangered animal.
questions.explain: Bütöv növ haqqında the + tək isim işlənir: The tiger is endangered.

questions.question: Who invented ___ telephone?
questions.explain: İxtiralar ümumi mənada the ilə işlənir: the telephone.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The dolphins are very intelligent animal.
Dolphin is a very intelligent animal.
questions.explain: Ümumi mənada artiklsız cəm isim işlənir: Dolphins are…

questions.question: She bought ___ dress for the party.
questions.explain: Sıra: fikir – ölçü – rəng (beautiful long red).

questions.question: We stayed in ___ house in Sheki.
questions.explain: Sıra: fikir – yaş – material (lovely old stone).

questions.question: Which phrase is in the correct order?
questions.explain: Sıra: ölçü – forma – material.

questions.question: It was ___ hot day that we stayed at home.
questions.explain: such a + sifət + tək isim: such a hot day.

questions.question: The questions were ___ difficult that nobody finished the test.
questions.explain: İsim olmadan sifətdən əvvəl so işlənir: so difficult that.

questions.question: They are ___ kind people! They always help us.
questions.explain: Cəm isimlə such (a-sız): such kind people.

questions.question: After the ten-hour walk we were absolutely ___.
questions.explain: absolutely yalnız güclü (ekstrem) sifətlərlə gəlir: absolutely exhausted.

questions.question: The view from the top of the mountain was ___ amazing.
questions.explain: amazing ekstrem sifətdir, very yox, absolutely ilə işlənir.

questions.question: It's ___ cold outside — wear a warm coat.
questions.explain: cold adi (dərəcəli) sifətdir, very ilə gəlir; absolutely freezing deyilir.

questions.question: We watched a ___ film last night.
questions.explain: Mürəkkəb sifətdə isim tək qalır: a two-hour film.

questions.question: Nizami Ganjavi is a ___ poet.
questions.explain: well + V3: well-known (məşhur).

questions.question: My brother is very ___ — he always helps people.
questions.explain: sifət + isim + -ed: kind-hearted (mehriban).

questions.question: Don't swim in that river — it's very ___.
questions.explain: danger + -ous = dangerous.

questions.question: This old phone is ___. It doesn't work at all.
questions.explain: -less 'olmayan' deməkdir: useless – faydasız.

questions.question: Nigar always has new and original ideas. She's very ___.
questions.explain: create + -ive = creative (yaradıcı).

questions.question: I've been very busy ___. I haven't seen my friends for weeks.
questions.explain: lately 'son vaxtlar' deməkdir; late isə 'gec'.

questions.question: It was so noisy that I could ___ hear the teacher.
questions.explain: hardly 'çətinliklə, demək olar ki' deməkdir.

questions.question: The bus was full and we ___ missed it.
questions.explain: nearly 'az qala' deməkdir; near 'yaxın'.

questions.question: It was ___ a good film, so I watched it twice.
questions.explain: Artikldən əvvəl yalnız quite (və rather) gələ bilər: quite a good film.

questions.question: The hotel was ___ expensive — 500 manats a night!
questions.explain: expensive adi sifətdir, extremely ilə güclənir; absolutely ekstrem sifətlərlədir.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: This book is fairly easy to read.
This book is fairly an easy to read.
This book is easy fairly to read.
This book is a fairly easy to read.
questions.explain: Dərəcə zərfi sifətdən əvvəl gəlir: fairly easy.

questions.question: I haven't finished my homework ___.
questions.explain: İnkar cümlənin sonunda yet işlənir.

questions.question: It's ten o'clock and Murad is ___ in bed.
questions.explain: still 'hələ də' – davam edən vəziyyət.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I have seen already this film.
Already I have seen this film.
I have already seen this film.
I have seen this film already yet.
questions.explain: already have ilə V3 arasında gəlir.

questions.question: Could you drive ___? You're going too fast.
questions.explain: -ly zərflərin müqayisəsi more ilə: more slowly.

questions.question: Leyla speaks English ___ than her brother.
questions.explain: well zərfinin müqayisə dərəcəsi better-dir.

questions.question: Nigar runs ___ of all the girls in her class.
questions.explain: fast → faster → the fastest.

questions.question: ___, it started to rain, so we couldn't play football.
questions.explain: Pis xəbər üçün Unfortunately (təəssüf ki).

questions.question: I missed the bus, but ___ my dad drove me to school.
questions.explain: Yaxşı nəticə üçün luckily (xoşbəxtlikdən).

questions.question: “You're from Baku, aren't you?” “___, I'm from Gabala.”
questions.explain: Səhv fikri düzəltmək üçün Actually (əslində).

topics.az: Hal və hərəkət feilləri, köməkçi feillər

questions.question: This bag ___ to my sister.
questions.explain: belong hal feilidir, continuous formada işlənmir.

questions.question: I ___ what you mean.
questions.explain: understand hal feilidir: I understand.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I am needing some help right now.
I need some help right now.
I needing some help right now.
I'm need some help right now.
questions.explain: need hal feilidir, right now olsa da Present Simple işlənir.

questions.question: At the moment I ___ about moving to Baku.
questions.explain: think about 'fikirləşmək' (hərəkət) mənasında continuous ola bilər.

questions.question: We ___ dinner now. Can I call you back later?
questions.explain: have dinner hərəkətdir, ona görə continuous: are having.

questions.question: This soup ___ delicious!
questions.explain: taste 'dadı var' (hal) mənasında continuous olmur.

questions.question: She's your cousin, ___?
questions.explain: Təsdiq cümləsi is → inkar tag: isn't she?

questions.question: They went to Sheki last weekend, ___?
questions.explain: went Past Simple-dir → didn't they?

questions.question: You can swim, ___?
questions.explain: Modal feil təkrarlanır: can → can't you?

questions.question: “I love chess.” “So ___ I.”
questions.explain: love Present Simple-dir, köməkçi feil do: So do I.

questions.question: “Nigar can't drive.” “Neither ___ her brother.”
questions.explain: Neither-dən sonra təsdiq formada köməkçi gəlir: Neither can ...

questions.question: “I didn't like the film.” “___”
questions.explain: İnkar fikrə razılıq: Neither did I.

questions.question: Don't worry if you ___ a mistake.
questions.explain: make a mistake – səhv etmək.

questions.question: Can you ___ a photo of us, please?
questions.explain: take a photo – şəkil çəkmək (make yox).

questions.question: I need to ___ some shopping after work.
questions.explain: do the shopping / do some shopping – alış-veriş etmək.

questions.question: Murad's parents are very proud ___ him.
questions.explain: "proud of" sabit birləşmədir.

questions.question: Your phone is very similar ___ mine.
questions.explain: "similar to" sabit birləşmədir; "similar with" səhvdir.

questions.question: Leyla is very keen ___ photography.
questions.explain: "keen on" — bir şeyə həvəsli olmaq.

questions.question: Whether we go to the beach or not depends ___ the weather.
questions.explain: "depend on" sabit birləşmədir; "depend from" səhvdir.

questions.question: I'd like to apologise ___ the mistake in your bill.
questions.explain: Bir şeyə görə üzr istəmək: "apologise for"; insana isə "apologise to".

questions.question: This bag doesn't belong ___ me.
questions.explain: "belong to" — kiməsə məxsus olmaq.

questions.question: What was the reason ___ your decision?
questions.explain: "reason for" sabit birləşmədir.

questions.question: Do you know the cause ___ the fire?
questions.explain: "the cause of" — bir şeyin səbəbi.

questions.question: One advantage ___ living in a big city is good public transport.
questions.explain: "advantage of" sabit birləşmədir.

questions.question: Sorry, I didn't break the window ___ purpose. It was an accident.
questions.explain: Qəsdən: "on purpose".

questions.question: I took your umbrella ___ mistake. I thought it was mine.
questions.explain: Səhvən: "by mistake".

questions.question: The lift is ___ order, so we'll have to use the stairs.
questions.explain: İşləmir, xarabdır: "out of order".

questions.question: I had a quick coffee before ___ for work.
questions.explain: Sözönündən sonra fel "-ing" formasında olur.

questions.question: You can improve your English by ___ films in English.
questions.explain: "by + -ing" bir şeyin necə edildiyini bildirir.

questions.question: My father insisted on ___ for dinner.
questions.explain: "insist on" sözönü ilə bitir, ona görə fel "-ing" alır.

skills.label: unless / as long as / in case

questions.question: ___ it was raining, we went for a walk.
questions.explain: Tam cümlədən (subyekt + fel) əvvəl "although" işlənir.

questions.question: We enjoyed the trip ___ the bad weather.
questions.explain: İsimdən əvvəl "despite" işlənir; "although" cümlə tələb edir.

questions.question: In spite of ___ tired, Tural finished his homework.
questions.explain: "in spite of"-dən sonra isim və ya "-ing" işlənir.

questions.question: The hotel was quite old. ___, the rooms were clean and comfortable.
questions.explain: Yeni cümlənin əvvəlində ziddiyyət üçün "However," işlənir.

questions.question: Living in a big city is exciting. ___, it can be very expensive.
questions.explain: Cümlənin əvvəlində digər tərəfi göstərmək üçün "On the other hand," işlənir.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I studied hard, however I failed the test.
I studied hard however, I failed the test.
Although I studied hard, but I failed the test.
I studied hard. However, I failed the test.
questions.explain: "However" adətən yeni cümləni başlayır və ondan sonra vergül qoyulur.

questions.question: I'm saving money ___ buy a new laptop.
questions.explain: Məqsəd bildirmək üçün fel əvvəli "to" işlənir; "for to" səhvdir.

questions.question: Please speak louder ___ everyone can hear you.
questions.explain: Ardınca subyekt + fel gəlirsə, "so that" işlənir.

questions.question: Nigar got up early ___ miss the bus.
questions.explain: İnkar məqsəd: "in order not to + fel".

questions.question: The flight was cancelled ___ the storm.
questions.explain: İsimdən əvvəl səbəb üçün "due to" işlənir; "because" cümlə tələb edir.

questions.question: ___ it was a holiday, all the shops were closed.
questions.explain: Cümlədən əvvəl səbəb bildirmək üçün "since" işlənir.

questions.question: The concert was cancelled because ___ the singer's illness.
questions.explain: İsimdən əvvəl "because of" işlənir.

questions.question: You can borrow my car ___ you drive carefully.
questions.explain: "as long as" — yalnız o şərtlə ki.

questions.question: Take an umbrella ___ it rains later.
questions.explain: Ehtiyat üçün: "in case" — birdən … olar deyə.

questions.question: I won't go to the party ___ Leyla goes too. I don't know anyone else there.
questions.explain: "unless" = "if … not": Leyla getməsə, mən də getmərəm.

questions.question: The new bridge ___ next year.
questions.explain: Gələcək passive: will be + V3.

questions.question: This house ___ in 1890.
questions.explain: Keçmiş zamanda passive: was/were + V3.

questions.question: “I'm tired,” he said yesterday. → He said that he ___ tired.
questions.explain: Dolayı nitqdə zaman bir pillə geri çəkilir.

questions.question: She asked me where I ___.
questions.explain: Dolayı sualda söz sırası təsdiq cümləsi kimidir.

questions.question: English ___ all over the world.
questions.explain: İndiki sadə zamanda passive: am/is/are + V3.

questions.question: “I will help you,” she said last month. → She said she ___ help me.
questions.explain: will → would.

questions.question: This form must ___ in black ink.
questions.explain: Modal passive: must + be + V3.

questions.question: The problem should ___ before the meeting tomorrow.
questions.explain: Modal passive: should + be + V3.

questions.question: The novel “Ali and Nino” ___ Kurban Said.
questions.explain: Passive cümlədə işi görən şəxs “by” ilə verilir.

questions.question: “I have finished my project,” Leyla said last week. → Leyla said she ___ her project.
questions.explain: Dolayı nitqdə present perfect → past perfect (had + V3) olur.

questions.question: “Do you like football?” he asked me. → He asked me ___ football.
questions.explain: “Bəli/xeyr” sualları dolayı nitqdə if/whether ilə, təsdiq söz sırası ilə verilir.

questions.question: The tourist asked me where the nearest metro station ___.
questions.explain: Dolayı sualda mübtəda feildən əvvəl gəlir: where the station was.

questions.question: The teacher told us ___ our phones in class.
questions.explain: Mənfi əmr dolayı nitqdə: tell someone not to + V1.

questions.question: She ___ me that the exam had been cancelled.
questions.explain: tell birbaşa obyekt (me) ilə işlənir, say və explain isə yox.

questions.question: My father suggested ___ to Gabala for the weekend.
questions.explain: suggest + V-ing (və ya suggest that…); suggest to go səhvdir.

questions.question: Can we ___ the meeting until next week?
questions.explain: put off = təxirə salmaq.

questions.question: I ran ___ an old friend at the airport.
questions.explain: run into = təsadüfən rastlaşmaq.

questions.question: We need to ___ a solution quickly.
questions.explain: come up with = (fikir, həll) tapmaq.

questions.question: “It's a piece of cake” means ___.
questions.explain: a piece of cake = çox asan iş.

questions.question: Please ___ the form and return it to reception.
questions.explain: fill in (və ya fill out) a form = formu doldurmaq.

questions.question: “Break the ice” means ___.
options: to start talking in an awkward situation
questions.explain: break the ice = gərginliyi aradan qaldırıb söhbətə başlamaq.

questions.question: I can't ___ this noise any longer!
questions.explain: put up with = dözmək, səbr etmək.

questions.question: We've ___ milk. Can you buy some on your way home?
questions.explain: run out of = qurtarmaq, tükənmək.

questions.question: “Once in a blue moon” means ___.
questions.explain: once in a blue moon = çox nadir hallarda.

questions.question: She turned down the job offer. Here, “turned down” means ___.
questions.explain: turn down an offer = təklifi rədd etmək.

questions.question: The match was called off because of the storm. “Called off” means ___.
questions.explain: call off = ləğv etmək (put off isə təxirə salmaqdır).

questions.question: My little brother takes after our grandfather. “Takes after” means ___.
questions.explain: take after = (ailə üzvünə) bənzəmək.

questions.question: These new phones cost an arm and a ___.
questions.explain: cost an arm and a leg = çox baha olmaq.

questions.question: I'm feeling a bit under the ___ today, so I'll stay at home.
questions.explain: under the weather = özünü bir az xəstə hiss etmək.

questions.question: It's a surprise party for Nigar, so don't let the ___ out of the bag!
questions.explain: let the cat out of the bag = sirri təsadüfən açmaq.

questions.question: She isn't answering. She ___ be in a meeting, but I'm not sure.
questions.explain: might = ola bilər (ehtimal, əmin deyiləm).

questions.question: He's been working for 12 hours. He ___ be exhausted.
questions.explain: must = yəqin ki (güclü əminlik).

questions.question: That ___ be Tom. He's in Paris this week.
questions.explain: can't = mümkün deyil (əminliklə inkar).

questions.question: I ___ have left my keys at the office, but I'm not sure.
questions.explain: Keçmişə aid ehtimal: might have + V3.

questions.question: The ground is wet. It ___ have rained last night.
questions.explain: Keçmişə aid əminlik: must have + V3.

questions.question: You ___ have told me! Now I look stupid.
questions.explain: should have + V3 = etməli idin (tənqid, peşmançılıq).

questions.question: Ramin's eyes are red and he keeps yawning. He ___ have slept well last night.
questions.explain: Keçmişə aid əminliklə inkar: can't have + V3.

questions.question: My phone isn't where I left it. I'm sure someone ___ have moved it.
questions.explain: “I'm sure” — keçmişə aid güclü əminlik: must have + V3.

questions.question: We ___ have taken a taxi — the hotel was only five minutes' walk away.
questions.explain: needn't have + V3 = etdik, amma lazım deyildi.

questions.question: I feel sick. I ___ so much cake.
questions.explain: shouldn't have + V3 = etməməli idim (peşmançılıq).

questions.question: The film was brilliant. You ___ come with us!
questions.explain: should have + V3 = gəlməli idin (təəssüf).

questions.question: Take an umbrella. According to the forecast, it's ___ to rain this afternoon.
questions.explain: be likely to + V1 = ehtimal ki; probable/possible bu quruluşda işlənmir.

questions.question: Ilham has trained every day for months, so he's ___ to win the race.
questions.explain: be bound to + V1 = mütləq, şübhəsiz.

questions.question: The traffic is terrible. We ___ well be late.
questions.explain: may well = çox güman ki (ehtimal yüksəkdir).

questions.question: Which sentence shows the STRONGEST certainty?
questions.explain: must ən güclü əminliyi bildirir; might/could/may isə sadəcə ehtimaldır.

questions.question: A newspaper article that gives the editor's opinion is called ___.
questions.explain: editorial = redaksiya məqaləsi (redaktorun fikri).

questions.question: The video went ___. Millions of people shared it within hours.
questions.explain: go viral = sürətlə yayılmaq.

questions.question: Not all news sources on social media are ___.
questions.explain: Sifət lazımdır: reliable = etibarlı.

questions.question: The government has ___ new measures to reduce unemployment.
questions.explain: introduce measures = tədbirlər tətbiq etmək.

questions.question: Advertisers often ___ young people because they spend a lot of time online.
questions.explain: target someone = kimisə hədəf seçmək (aim isə “at” tələb edir).

questions.question: There is a growing ___ between the rich and the poor.
questions.explain: the gap between rich and poor — sabit birləşmə.

questions.question: The short text under a photo in a newspaper is called a ___.
questions.explain: caption = şəklin altındakı izah yazısı.

questions.question: The newspaper has a daily ___ of over 200,000 copies.
questions.explain: circulation = qəzetin tirajı.

questions.question: Be careful what you post online — your digital ___ can stay there forever.
questions.explain: digital footprint = internetdə qoyduğun iz.

questions.question: People who post rude comments online just to upset others are called ___.
questions.explain: troll = başqalarını qəsdən əsəbiləşdirən istifadəçi.

questions.question: The company launched a huge advertising ___ to promote its new phone.
questions.explain: advertising campaign = reklam kampaniyası.

questions.question: A famous footballer was paid to ___ the new sports drink.
questions.explain: endorse a product = məhsulu reklam edib dəstəkləmək.

questions.question: Many young people move to Baku in search of better job ___.
questions.explain: job opportunities = iş imkanları.

questions.question: Many people are ___ about what they read online.
questions.explain: be + sifət: sceptical = şübhə ilə yanaşan.

questions.question: Freedom of ___ is an important right in a democratic society.
questions.explain: of-dan sonra isim: freedom of expression = söz azadlığı.

questions.question: I don't have a car. I wish I ___ one.
questions.explain: İndiki vəziyyətə təəssüf: wish + Past Simple.

questions.question: Nigar's house is far from school. She wishes she ___ closer.
questions.explain: İndiki vəziyyət üçün wish + Past Simple işlənir; öz hərəkətimiz üçün would işlənmir.

questions.question: I wish I ___ speak French — the job in Paris sounds perfect.
questions.explain: İndiki bacarıq haqqında arzu: wish + could.

questions.question: I wish I ___ harder before last week's exam.
questions.explain: Keçmişə təəssüf: wish + had + V3.

questions.question: Tural regrets not going to the concert. He wishes he ___ to it.
questions.explain: Keçmişdə baş verməyən hadisəyə təəssüf: wish + had + V3.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I wish I hadn't said that to her yesterday.
I wish I didn't say that to her yesterday.
I wish I wouldn't say that to her yesterday.
I wish I haven't said that to her yesterday.
questions.explain: Keçmiş hadisəyə (yesterday) təəssüf: wish + hadn't + V3.

questions.question: I wish you ___ interrupting me all the time! It's so annoying.
questions.explain: Başqasının vərdişindən şikayət: wish + would + V1.

questions.question: If only it ___ raining! We want to go outside.
questions.explain: Dəyişməsini istədiyimiz vəziyyət üçün: if only + would + V1.

questions.question: Murad's sister always takes his things without asking. He says: “I wish she ___ my things without asking!”
questions.explain: Başqasının təkrarlanan hərəkətindən narazılıq: wish + wouldn't + V1.

questions.question: If we ___ earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
questions.explain: Üçüncü şərt: If + had + V3, would have + V3.

questions.question: You fell because you were running. You ___ if you had walked more carefully.
questions.explain: Keçmişdəki qeyri-real nəticə: would have + V3.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: If I would have known, I would have told you.
If I knew, I would have told you yesterday.
If I had known, I would have told you.
If I had known, I will have told you.
questions.explain: If hissəsində would işlənmir: If + had + V3, would have + V3.

questions.question: It's late, children. It's time you ___ to bed.
questions.explain: It's time + şəxs + Past Simple: indiki an üçün keçmiş forma işlənir.

questions.question: “Shall I come to the meeting?” “I'd rather you ___ at home and finished the report.”
questions.explain: Başqa şəxs üçün would rather + şəxs + Past Simple işlənir.

questions.question: It's high time the government ___ something about traffic in Baku.
questions.explain: It's high time + Past Simple: bunu artıq etmək lazım idi.

questions.question: Don't call me at 8 tonight — I ___ dinner with my family then.
questions.explain: Gələcəkdə müəyyən anda davam edən hərəkət: will be + V-ing.

questions.question: This time tomorrow, I ___ on the plane to London.
questions.explain: "This time tomorrow" — o anda davam edəcək hərəkət: will be + V-ing.

questions.question: “___ the car tomorrow? I need to borrow it.”
questions.explain: Başqasının planları haqqında nəzakətli sual: Will you be + V-ing?

questions.question: By the end of this year, Murad ___ his degree.
questions.explain: Gələcəkdə müəyyən vaxta qədər bitəcək hərəkət: will have + V3.

questions.question: Hurry up! The film ___ by the time we get to the cinema.
questions.explain: "By the time" ilə gələcəkdə artıq baş vermiş olacaq hadisə: will have + V3.

questions.question: In June, my parents ___ married for 25 years.
questions.explain: Gələcək anadək davam edən vəziyyət (stative): will have been.

questions.question: By 6 o'clock, I ___ for eight hours without a break.
questions.explain: Gələcək anadək müddət vurğulanır: will have been + V-ing.

questions.question: By next month, Nigar ___ English for ten years.
questions.explain: Gələcəkdə müəyyən vaxta qədər davam edən müddət: will have been + V-ing.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: By the time she retires, she will be teaching for 40 years.
By the time she will retire, she will have been teaching for 40 years.
By the time she retires, she has been teaching for 40 years.
By the time she retires, she will have been teaching for 40 years.
questions.explain: Zaman budaq cümləsində will işlənmir; əsas cümlədə will have been + V-ing.

questions.question: I'll wait here ___ you come back.
questions.explain: Until — hərəkət o ana qədər davam edir.

questions.question: Please send me the report ___ Friday at the latest.
questions.explain: By — "ən gec o vaxta qədər" (son tarix).

questions.question: ___ you arrive, we will have cleaned the whole house.
questions.explain: By the time + cümlə: o vaxta qədər artıq (will have + V3).

questions.question: Hurry! The train is ___ leave.
questions.explain: Be about to + V1: indicə baş verəcək.

questions.question: The plane is ___ to land at 7:45, but it might be delayed.
questions.explain: Be due to — cədvəl üzrə gözlənilən vaxt; about to ilə dəqiq saat işlənmir.

questions.question: Rəşidə was on the point of ___ up when she finally found the answer.
questions.explain: On the point of + V-ing: nəyisə etmək üzrə olmaq.

questions.question: A person who breaks into houses to steal things is a ___.
questions.explain: Evə gizlicə girib oğurluq edən şəxs burglar adlanır; robber zor tətbiq edərək soyur.

questions.question: He was caught leaving a shop with a jacket he hadn't paid for. He was arrested for ___.
questions.explain: Mağazadan pul ödəmədən mal götürmək shoplifting adlanır.

questions.question: Someone took my wallet out of my bag on the crowded bus. It must have been a ___.
questions.explain: İzdihamda cibdən/çantadan oğurlayan şəxs pickpocket adlanır.

questions.question: After a three-week trial, the jury reached a ___ of “not guilty”.
questions.explain: Andlılar məhkəməsinin qərarı verdict adlanır.

questions.question: The judge ___ him to five years in prison.
questions.explain: Hakim cəza təyin edir: sentence somebody to + müddət.

questions.question: Which is the correct order of events?
questions.explain: Əvvəl həbs, sonra ittiham, sonra məhkəmə və nəhayət hökm gəlir.

questions.question: Anyone who ___ a crime should be punished.
questions.explain: Düzgün birləşmə: commit a crime.

questions.question: If you park on the pavement, you'll have to pay a ___.
questions.explain: Qanun pozuntusuna görə ödənilən pul fine adlanır.

questions.question: He says he has never ___ the law in his life.
questions.explain: Düzgün birləşmə: break the law.

questions.question: The police have no ___ that he was involved. (PROVE)
questions.explain: Prove feilinin isim forması proof-dur.

questions.question: The jury had no doubt about his ___. (GUILTY)
questions.explain: Guilty sifətinin isim forması guilt-dir.

questions.question: The ___ was caught on camera leaving the shop. (THEFT)
questions.explain: Theft cinayətin, thief isə cinayətkarın adıdır.

questions.question: She was accused ___ stealing money from her employer.
questions.explain: Accuse somebody of + V-ing.

questions.question: He has been charged ___ murder.
questions.explain: Charge somebody with + cinayət.

questions.question: He was found guilty ___ fraud.
questions.explain: Guilty of + cinayət.

questions.question: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset.
questions.explain: İnkar zərfi cümlənin əvvəlində gələndə inversiya olur: Never have I…

questions.question: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
questions.explain: Not only cümlənin əvvəlində gəldikdə inversiya olur: Not only was he…

questions.question: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now.
questions.explain: Qarışıq şərt: keçmişdəki şərt → indiki nəticə.

questions.question: ___ I known about the problem, I would have helped.
questions.explain: Had I known = If I had known.

questions.question: Hardly ___ the house when it started to rain.
questions.explain: Hardly … when quruluşunda inversiya: Hardly had we left…

questions.question: If she weren't so shy, she ___ to the party last night.
questions.explain: İndiki xüsusiyyət → keçmiş nəticə: would have + V3.

questions.question: Little ___ that his life was about to change completely.
questions.explain: Little cümlənin əvvəlində: Little did he know (inversiya).

questions.question: No sooner ___ the door than the phone rang.
questions.explain: No sooner had + mübtəda + V3 … than.

questions.question: Scarcely had the concert started ___ the lights went out.
questions.explain: Scarcely/Hardly … when; No sooner … than.

questions.question: ___ you need any further information, please do not hesitate to contact us.
questions.explain: Should you need = If you (should) need — rəsmi şərt inversiyası.

questions.question: ___ the government to raise taxes, there would be widespread protests.
questions.explain: Were + mübtəda + to V1 = If the government were to…

questions.question: If I ___ the job in London last year, I would be living there now.
questions.explain: Keçmiş şərt (had + V3) → indiki nəticə (would + V1).

questions.question: Had she taken the medicine, she ___ better now.
questions.explain: Had she taken (keçmiş) → indiki nəticə: would feel … now.

questions.question: If he spoke Azerbaijani, he ___ the film yesterday without subtitles.
questions.explain: İndiki vəziyyət (spoke) → keçmiş nəticə: would have + V3.

questions.question: Were he more organised, he ___ his passport at home yesterday.
questions.explain: Were he (indiki xüsusiyyət) → keçmiş nəticə: wouldn't have + V3.

questions.question: The results ___ that the new method is more effective.
questions.explain: indicate that… = göstərmək (nəticələr göstərir ki…).

questions.question: The study was ___ out over a period of two years.
questions.explain: carry out research/a study = tədqiqat aparmaq.

questions.question: There is ___ evidence to support this theory.
questions.explain: Düzgün inkar prefiksi: in-sufficient.

questions.question: The two variables are closely ___.
questions.explain: be closely correlated = sıx əlaqəli olmaq (korrelyasiya).

questions.question: In ___, the findings suggest that further research is needed.
questions.explain: Sabit ifadə: In conclusion.

questions.question: The author ___ a number of arguments in favour of reform.
questions.explain: put forward an argument = arqument irəli sürmək.

questions.question: Critics have ___ that the sample size was too small.
questions.explain: argue that… = iddia etmək, əsaslandırmaq.

questions.question: The researchers were unable to ___ any firm conclusions from the data.
questions.explain: draw conclusions = nəticə çıxarmaq.

questions.question: The results were ___ with those of previous studies.
questions.explain: consistent sözünün inkarı in- prefiksi ilə: inconsistent.

questions.question: The data were ___, which led to false conclusions.
questions.explain: mis- prefiksi “səhv” mənası verir: misinterpret = səhv yozmaq.

questions.question: The first experiment failed. ___, the second produced promising results.
questions.explain: In contrast = bunun əksinə (ziddiyyət bildirir).

questions.question: The method is cheap; ___, it is faster than the alternatives.
questions.explain: moreover = bundan əlavə (fikri gücləndirir).

questions.question: These results ___ that the drug may be effective, although more research is needed.
questions.explain: suggest ehtiyatlı ifadədir; prove/confirm/establish isə tam əminlik bildirir.

questions.question: The findings ___ to support the hypothesis, but the sample was small.
questions.explain: appear to + V1 = görünür ki (ehtiyatlı ifadə).

questions.question: According to most economists, prices are ___ to rise further next year.
questions.explain: be likely to + V1 = ehtimal ki; probably zərfdir.

questions.question: She made a ___ decision to change her career.
questions.explain: İsimdən əvvəl sifət: a conscious decision.

questions.question: We need to ___ a balance between work and family.
questions.explain: strike a balance — sabit birləşmə.

questions.question: The company is facing ___ competition from abroad.
questions.explain: fierce competition = sərt rəqabət.

questions.question: Her ___ to detail is impressive.
questions.explain: attention to detail — isim lazımdır.

questions.question: It's ___ unlikely that prices will fall this year.
questions.explain: highly unlikely — sabit birləşmə.

questions.question: The plan was ___ rejected by the committee.
questions.explain: Feili təyin edən zərf: unanimously.

questions.question: The new law will ___ effect from January.
questions.explain: take effect = qüvvəyə minmək.

questions.question: She ___ a lot of pressure on herself before exams.
questions.explain: put pressure on someone = təzyiq göstərmək.

questions.question: We must ___ the consequences of our actions.
questions.explain: face the consequences = nəticələrlə üzləşmək.

questions.question: There was ___ rain all night, and several streets in Baku were flooded.
questions.explain: heavy rain = güclü yağış.

questions.question: She has a ___ interest in modern art.
questions.explain: a keen interest = böyük maraq.

questions.question: The two scientists had a ___ debate that lasted for hours.
questions.explain: a heated debate = qızğın mübahisə.

questions.question: I was ___ aware of the risks before I signed the contract.
questions.explain: fully aware = tam xəbərdar.

questions.question: She was ___ disappointed when she didn't get the scholarship.
questions.explain: bitterly disappointed = çox məyus.

questions.question: His ___ to compromise led to the failure of the negotiations.
questions.explain: His-dən sonra isim lazımdır: unwillingness.

questions.question: It was Leyla ___ found the solution, not Murad.
questions.explain: It-cleft-də şəxs üçün who (və ya that) işlənir; burada mübtədadır, whom yox.

questions.question: It was in 2015 ___ they moved to Baku.
questions.explain: Zaman vurğulananda It was ... that quruluşu işlənir.

questions.question: It ___ until I got home that I realised I'd lost my phone.
questions.explain: It wasn't until ... that — "yalnız ... sonra" mənasında.

questions.question: ___ I need right now is a long holiday.
questions.explain: Wh-cleft: What + cümlə + is/was + vurğulanan hissə.

questions.question: What surprised me most ___ how calm she was.
questions.explain: Wh-cleft-də What-hissədən sonra tək halda be gəlir: was.

questions.question: What he did ___ call the police immediately.
questions.explain: What + subject + did + was + (to) V1.

questions.question: I didn't want anything expensive. ___ I wanted was a bit of peace and quiet.
questions.explain: All ... was — "yeganə istədiyim" mənasında vurğu.

questions.question: The reason ___ I'm late is that the bus broke down.
questions.explain: The reason why ... is that ... quruluşu işlənir.

questions.question: The thing ___ annoys me most is his constant lateness.
questions.explain: The thing that/which ... is ...; the thing-dən sonra what işlənmir.

questions.question: “You didn't lock the door!” “I ___ lock it — I remember checking!”
questions.explain: Keçmişdə vurğu üçün did + V1 işlənir.

questions.question: She doesn't like many sports, but she ___ enjoy tennis.
questions.explain: İndiki zamanda üçüncü şəxs təkdə vurğu: does + V1.

questions.question: Which sentence uses emphatic “do” correctly?
options: I do hope you'll come to the party.
I do hoping you'll come to the party.
I does hope you'll come to the party.
I do to hope you'll come to the party.
questions.explain: Vurğulu do-dan sonra feil məsdər şəklində (V1) gəlir.

questions.question: This is by ___ the best book I've read this year.
questions.explain: Üstünlük dərəcəsini gücləndirmək üçün by far işlənir.

questions.question: It was ___ a boring film that I fell asleep.
questions.explain: Such + a + sifət + isim + that.

questions.question: At that ___ moment, the lights went out.
questions.explain: The/that very + isim — "məhz o" mənasında vurğu.

questions.question: ___ down the street, I saw an old friend.
questions.explain: Eyni vaxtda baş verən aktiv hərəkət: V-ing.

questions.question: ___ that it was going to rain, she took an umbrella.
questions.explain: Səbəb bildirən aktiv tərkib: V-ing (= Because she knew).

questions.question: He sat by the window, ___ the rain.
questions.explain: Eyni vaxtda davam edən hərəkət: V-ing.

questions.question: ___ in 1890, the building is one of the oldest in Baku.
questions.explain: Passiv məna: bina tikilib — V3.

questions.question: ___ by the news, she couldn't say a word.
questions.explain: O, xəbərdən təsirlənib — passiv məna: V3.

questions.question: ___ properly, this medicine is completely safe.
questions.explain: = If it is taken properly — passiv məna: V3.

questions.question: ___ her homework, Nigar went out to play tennis.
questions.explain: Əvvəl bitmiş aktiv hərəkət: Having + V3.

questions.question: ___ the film before, I didn't want to see it again.
questions.explain: Əsas hərəkətdən əvvəl baş vermiş hərəkət: Having + V3.

questions.question: ___ twice, he decided not to apply again.
questions.explain: Əvvəl baş vermiş passiv hərəkət: Having been + V3.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Running for the bus, my keys fell out of my pocket.
Running for the bus, I dropped my keys.
Running for the bus, my keys were dropped.
Ran for the bus, I dropped my keys.
questions.explain: Tərkibin mübtədası əsas cümlənin mübtədası ilə eyni olmalıdır: qaçan "I"-dır.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Having eaten lunch, we went back to work.
Having eaten lunch, the work started again.
Having eaten lunch, work was continued.
Eaten lunch, we went back to work.
questions.explain: Nahar edən "we"-dir, ona görə əsas cümlənin mübtədası "we" olmalıdır.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Looking out of the window, the mountains were beautiful.
Looking out of the window, the mountains could be seen.
Looking out of the window, she saw the mountains.
Looked out of the window, she saw the mountains.
questions.explain: Pəncərədən baxan "she"-dir, dağlar yox.

questions.question: The man ___ next to me on the plane was a famous writer.
questions.explain: = the man who was sitting — qısaldılmış formada V-ing qalır.

questions.question: Most of the goods ___ in this factory are exported.
questions.explain: = which are made — passiv məna: V3.

questions.question: Anyone ___ to join the club should contact Leyla.
questions.explain: = anyone who wishes — aktiv məna: V-ing.

questions.question: Everyone else is working hard, but Kamal isn't pulling his ___.
questions.explain: Pull your weight — öz payına düşən işi görmək.

questions.question: If you cut ___ when building a house, it may not be safe.
questions.explain: Cut corners — işi tez/ucuz bitirmək üçün keyfiyyəti qurban vermək.

questions.question: “She burns the midnight oil before every exam.” This means she ___.
questions.explain: Burn the midnight oil — gecə gec saatlara qədər oxumaq/işləmək.

questions.question: Prices have gone up, so we'll have to tighten our ___ for a few months.
questions.explain: Tighten your belt — xərcləri azaltmaq.

questions.question: With two jobs, Rəşidə can barely make ends ___.
questions.explain: Make ends meet — güclə dolanmaq, pulu çatdırmaq.

questions.question: A weekend in Gabala won't break the ___ — it's quite cheap.
questions.explain: Not break the bank — çox baha olmamaq.

questions.question: When she got the scholarship, she was over the ___.
questions.explain: Over the moon — çox xoşbəxt olmaq.

questions.question: “Tural has been on edge all week.” This means he has been ___.
questions.explain: On edge — əsəbi, gərgin olmaq.

questions.question: When I told my dad I'd crashed his car, he hit the ___.
questions.explain: Hit the roof — çox əsəbiləşmək, hirslənmək.

questions.question: Before deciding, let's look at the pros and ___.
questions.explain: Pros and cons — müsbət və mənfi cəhətlər.

questions.question: I'm sick and ___ of hearing the same excuses.
questions.explain: Sick and tired of — nədənsə bezmək.

questions.question: ___ and large, the trip was a success, despite a few problems.
questions.explain: By and large — ümumilikdə, əsasən.

questions.question: It's expensive now, but in the long ___ it will save you money.
questions.explain: In the long run — uzun müddətdə, gələcəkdə.

questions.question: At the end of the ___, it's your decision, not mine.
questions.explain: At the end of the day — son nəticədə.

questions.question: I can't tell you the exact price off the top of my ___, but it's around 200 manat.
questions.explain: Off the top of my head — dəqiq yoxlamadan, yaddaşdan.
